thread:
eva: quick heads-up — i'm preparing a small rename sweep across docs and examples this week. want to coordinate so SDK and examples teams don't get surprised.

omar: what are the renames? can you drop a short list?

eva: short list: `model_tag` -> `model_id`; refer to the product offering as `Dedicated` (title case) when it's the product; prefer 'model variant' instead of calling something a 'fallback', and always spell out acronyms on first use (e.g., 'RLHF' -> 'reinforcement learning from human feedback'). Also prefer 'per-token' in billing copy.

jin: i can update the node/python snippets. will we keep compatibility?

eva: yes — SDKs will accept both names for two releases. docs should use the new canonical terms. i'll add a migration note above affected snippets.

tara: i'll run a repo-wide search for the old terms (both code and prose) and open a single docs PR with fixes.

omar: i'm updating the Go SDK docs and will add deprecation comments. i'll link PR 821 when ready.

docs-bot: noted. will run link/anchor checks once PRs are referenced here.

tara: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/822 — replaces in examples and adds migration blurb in each README.

im: small nit: make sure we don't change historical changelog entries; keep those verbatim.

eva: good call. preserve history. merge order plan: examples & SDK docs first, site-wide canonical table second. aim to merge by EOD Friday.

docs-bot: queued checks for PRs: 821, 822. initial scan: 1 image path in examples/embeddings needs fixing.

eva: tara/omar — can you patch that image path in your branches? i'll hold the canonical table merge until all green.

tara: pushed fix. retesting.

docs-bot: re-run done: no broken links. ready for review.

eva: great work. i'll publish the style table update after these PRs land. thanks everyone.
